messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "you may need to use blood pressure medication for the rest of your life"
set: ["you may need to use blood pressure medication for the rest of your life", "you may need frequent blood tests", "your blood pressure will need to be checked often", "your heart and blood pressure may also need to be checked often", "may need to slowly decrease dose of other medication", "may need to prime your albuterol inhaler device before the first use", "you may need to stop using the medicine for a short time", "especially heart or blood pressure medication", "you may need regular blood tests, blood pressure checks and eye checks during long-term treatment", "usually taken for life", "may need to stop use before imaging tests", "may also need to shake your albuterol device just before each use", "monitor for blood pressure changes", "use medication regularly", "continue use for high blood pressure even if feeling fine", "you may need a higher dose for a short time"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
